newsitem.title: USA: Friedman's sees Q3 EPS between $0.11-$0.14.
newsitem.headline: Friedman's sees Q3 EPS between $0.11-$0.14.

text.p: Friedman's Inc said third quarter net income and revenue will be below consensus estimates, and said earnings per share will likely be between $0.11 and $0.14 for the quarter.

It said merchandise sales for the third quarter, which ended June 30, will be about $45.8 million, an increase from last year, but a decrease from expected levels. It said the lower expected net income and earnings per share are primarily due to the short-fall in sales.
The company reported a loss of $20,000 ($0.00 per share) in the third quarter last year.

Comparable store sales declined by about 4.7 percent during the third quarter. Friedman's said the entire decrease in comparable store sales is attributable to a decline in credit sales, as cash sales in comparable stores and new stores achieved management's expectations.
Earnings per share for the nine months ended June 30, are estimated to be $1.18 to $1.21 per share and EPS for the year are estimated to be $1.33 to $1.36 per share.
The company reported a profit of $0.94 a share for the nine months ended June 30, 1996 and a profit of $1.06 a share for the year ended September 30, 1996.
